📖 Unified Schema Data Dictionary

Field SQL Type Description Engineering Rationale & Example
review_idINTEGER PKUnique review identifierPrevents duplicates and cross-split contamination (1, 2, ... 15000)
brandVARCHAR(64)Automobile manufacturerStandardized 15 OEMs (e.g. "Toyota", "Tata Motors", "Mahindra")
vehicle_modelVARCHAR(128)Vehicle model nameNormalized catalog model (e.g. "Camry", "Nexon", "Thar", "Harrier")
review_text_originalTEXTRaw consumer review textPreserved unmodified for research audit and evidence extraction
sentimentVARCHAR(16)Ground-truth label3-class target: 'positive', 'neutral', 'negative'
review_text_processedTEXTNegation-preserved cleaned text"engine is not_bad but mileage is not_good" (negation bound as single token)

🔧 Data Preprocessing & Quality Engineering LEAK-FREE AUDIT

End-to-end data sanitization, negation-preserving tokenization, and stratified leak-free partitioning.

Automotive NLP Preprocessing Pipeline Flow

📥 1. Raw Multi-Source CSV & Excel Ingestion
🧹 2. HTML & Noise Strip &amp; → and, tags removed
📝 3. Contraction Expand don't → do not, won't → will not
🔗 4. Negation Preservation not good → not_good
✂️ 5. Spec Token Filtering Keep mpg, bhp, abs, adas
🎯 6. Stratified Split 70 / 15 / 15 Seed 42

Before & After Text Sanitization Examples

Case 1: Negation & Noise
Raw: "The engine isn't bad but the mileage is NOT great at all!!! &amp; seats don't feel comfortable."
Cleaned: "the engine is not_bad but the mileage is not_great at all and seats do not_feel comfortable"
• "not_bad" preserved as positive valence particle; "not_great" retained as negative.
Case 2: Vehicle Spec Acronyms
Raw: "ABS & ADAS brakes saved me twice, but NVH levels on highway are terrible (85+ dB)."
Cleaned: "abs and adas brakes saved me twice but nvh levels on highway are terrible 85 db"
• Automotive acronyms (ABS, ADAS, NVH) preserved for aspect mapping.
Case 3: Extreme Exclamation & Emotion
Raw: "TERRIBLE experience! Car won't start in freezing cold & dealership service was zero HELP!!"
Cleaned: "terrible experience car will not_start in freezing cold and dealership service was zero help"
• "won't start" normalized to "will not_start"; uppercase de-noised without losing sentiment.
